units: Defines expected preserve/expand/authority-decay/attribution labels for stable, contradiction, noise, and representation cases.
Expected fixture values are normative test expectations, not empirical results.
Defines residual 1 with positive feedback expecting mismatch detection.
Scenario dictionaries are synthetic test inputs, not observations.
Successful trace contains residual, authority revision 1, confidence revision 0.5, authority_changed true.
Failed trace contains residual, authority revision 0, confidence revision 1, authority_changed false.
Synthetic telemetry traces are fixtures, not run records.
File claims to validate contradiction -> attribution -> authority update -> representation update -> improved adaptation.
Integration AdaptiveAgent expects inheritance, REE, MRAT components and an initial mechanism/representation.
adapt() expects mrat.attribute residual and attenuates mechanism when attribution layer is mechanism.
adapt() calls REE evaluate with fixed residual/value/cost and expects expansion mutation if expanded.
Golden test expects contradiction to reduce initial mechanism weight and create REE expansion history.

Tests expect no expansion without pressure, layer-specific repair, repeated mechanism-failure decay, adaptive vs baseline authority difference, and telemetry containing residual plus authority revision.

Integration imports/uses AdaptiveInheritanceEngine, add_mechanism, weights, MRAT.attribute/layer, REE set_representation/expand/history, and PTVSEnvironment.step, none matching frozen implementations.
Integration constructs RAHUEvaluator() without required tasks argument.
Integration test intent cannot be promoted to an executed end-to-end validation without run evidence.
